payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed G-SAT model outperforms existing systems in terms of accuracy and efficiency, as it maintains high-level performance while being significantly faster than state-of-the-art systems.

claims.text: The G-SAT model provides competitive advantages over state-of-the-art DST systems in terms of accuracy.
The G-SAT model is over 15 times faster than existing systems while maintaining accuracy.
The G-SAT model outperforms state-of-the-art systems even without pre-trained embeddings.
